Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

Calling themselves the Angels of Caine, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} antitribu broke from their independent kin to pursue a closer spiritual bond with Caine, whom mainstream Assamites consider corrupt. Despite the schism, the two branches retain a wary mutual respect. @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} antitribu serve the Sword of Caine as elite assassins and shock troops, prizing their clan's martial traditions even above the sect's own doctrines, and their most honored members hold the title of hulul.

Disciplines: Celerity, Obfuscate, Quietus

Advantage: All Assamites gain one Melee and one Brawl Ability at no cost.

Disadvantage: Assamites hunger for vampiric vitae. After tasting a particular vampire's blood, the player must pass a Self-Control/Instinct Test (difficulty 4 Traits) or become addicted to it; on later encountering that Kindred they must test again or frenzy, attempting to devour them.

Organization: Assamite antitribu hold their parent clan's traditions in high regard, often forming tight cells bound by oaths to the hulul, and prioritize clan loyalty alongside their service to the Sabbat.
